text: Completed in 9a938c1. PlotLayer, PackedLayerPlan/PackedStatPlan, and TrainedLayer keep each layer row type attached to data, mappings, stats, resolved rows, and dropped provenance. addIndependentLayer and the DSL require explicit independent data plus LayerFacetPolicy Repeat, Exclude, or typed Select; plot inheritance remains only for same-row layers. Plot-global scale observations now train across heterogeneous packages. The only new erasure recovery is the package-identity-guarded facet alignment boundary. Added mixed-scale, dropped-source, facet-policy, DSL, and renderer-conformance coverage. Detached commit verification: sbt graphicsJVM/test graphicsJS/test passed 207 tests on each backend with no warnings.
